levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب
عبد الله بن عامر بن سعد الأشعري

notes: «حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي» gives the compiler's father by relation only, with no name: a relation link. He is paired with محمد بن الحسن by «قالا».
«جميعا» marks the three names of the second level as co-transmitters; «قالوا حدثنا» starts the fourth-level group of four.
The Imam after «عن» stays a narrator; «قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ» gives his words as the saying. The blessings are not part of any surface.
